bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDQ is issuer-native on Ethereum, Polygon, XRPL, Algorand and Stellar (the exact Stellar identity was supplemented from current issuer/TOML sources on 2026-10-20 without renewing the original review or other controls). The original review identifies official LayerZero Value Transfer API bidirectional Ethereum-to-Polygon USDQ transfers through a Stargate V2 Taxi liquidity route. That route is third-party liquidity settlement around the two native USDQ deployments, not native Mint Authority. Direction-specific VTA controls preserve the TransferDelegate and LZMulticall failure domains; the USDQ-specific pool or transaction, peer/DVN/executor set, rate limits, pause and upgrade controls, and administrator identities remain unresolved.

protocols.name: LayerZero / Stargate
protocols.note: Quantoz announced LayerZero messaging and Stargate liquidity transport for EURQ/USDQ cross-chain transfers. The current Value Transfer API supports USDQ in both directions between Ethereum and Polygon; it is a third-party liquidity route rather than evidence that the HadronToken deployments are bridge representations.

protocols.name: LayerZero Value Transfer API
protocols.note: LayerZero's official Value Transfer API documentation identifies Stargate V2 Taxi as a unified pool/liquidity transfer path with LayerZero messaging. USDQ-specific quote execution requires an API key, so the concrete pool transaction and route configuration remain unresolved.
